extracted.intended_audience: registered patent practitioners and attorneys involved in USPTO disciplinary/reinstatement proceedings
extracted.subtask_description: An Office of Enrollment and Discipline decision on a petition to reinstate a suspended practitioner to practice before the USPTO, based on review of the petition and the record for compliance with a prior disciplinary order. The document records the Director's determination to grant reinstatement when the petitioner has complied with the terms of the final order.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility for reinstatement
rubrics_metrics.description: Reinstatement is considered after review of the petition and all information in the record material to the petitioner's eligibility; reinstatement may be granted where the Director determines the petitioner has complied with all provisions of the final order.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: As shown in this decision: the Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline reviews the petition and the record regarding eligibility for reinstatement and will grant reinstatement when the petitioner has complied with all provisions of the prior final order (example: Mr. Vyas, suspended for 30 days, was found to have complied and his petition was granted).
